source.title: Ulster Herald, 20 May 1967, p. 14 ("Fights also for four rural councils: nominations")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Contests from the Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8, checked against the News-Letter and Irish News; unopposed returns from the Ulster Herald, 20 May 1967, p. 14.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Two divisions were contested, Newtownstewart and Sion, 'the first in the history of the Council' (Ulster Herald, 20 May 1967, p. 14); the other 26 seats were filled unopposed. Doorat, missing from the paper's list of unopposed members, is recorded from the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Ulster Herald, 10 June 1967, p. 12). Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
